# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
```
 
# Packages
```{r packages}
# List of required packages
list_of_packages <- c("MASS", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "caret", "rpart", "tidyr", "glmnet" ,"synthpop", "purrr", "MonteCarlo", "tidyverse", "Matrix", "caret", "bnlearn", "stringr", "future", "furrr", "parallelly")

# Function to install a package if it is not already installed
install_if_missing <- function(p){
  if(!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)){
    install.packages(p)
  }
  library(p, character.only=TRUE)
}

# Install and load packages
lapply(list_of_packages, install_if_missing)
```
 
# Load simulation data
```{r load-data}
sim_hierarchical <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "sim_hierarchical.rds"))
sim_linear <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "sim_linear.rds"))
 
expected_names <- unlist(lapply(c(6, 12, 18), function(p) paste0("p", p, "_mc", 1:5)))
 
missing_hier <- setdiff(expected_names, names(sim_hierarchical))
missing_linear <- setdiff(expected_names, names(sim_linear))
 
if (length(missing_hier) > 0) {stop(
    "Missing hierarchical datasets: ",
    paste(missing_hier, collapse = ", "))}
 
if (length(missing_linear) > 0) {stop(
    "Missing parametric datasets: ",
    paste(missing_linear, collapse = ", "))}
 
cat("Hierarchical datasets:", length(sim_hierarchical), "\n")
cat("Parametric datasets:", length(sim_linear), "\n")
```
 
# Load synthesis functions
```{r synthesis-functions}
source(here::here("code", "synthesis.R"))
```
 
# Synthesis methods
```{r synthesis-methods}
synth_methods <- list(
  parm = list(name = "parm", func = synthesize_data_parametric),
  cart = list(name = "cart", func = synthesize_data_cart),
  bn = list( name = "bn", func = synthesize_data_bn),
  svm = list(name = "svm", func = synthesize_data_svm))
 
run_and_save_synthesis <- function(data, 
                                   method, 
                                   object_name, 
                                   mc_reps = 5,
                                   output_dir = here::here("data")) {
 
  cat("\nRunning", method$name, "synthesis for", length(data), "original datasets...\n")
 
  result <- synthesize_data_model(
    simulated_data = data,
    synth_method = method,
    mc_reps = mc_reps)
 
  assign(object_name, result, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
 
  output_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(object_name, ".RData"))
  save(list = object_name, file = output_path, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  invisible(result)
}
```
 
# Hierarchical simulation: synthesis
 
## Parametric synthesis
```{r parm-hierarchical}
parm_hiersyn <- run_and_save_synthesis(
  data = sim_hierarchical,
  method = synth_methods$parm,
  object_name = "parm_hiersyn")
```

## SVM synthesis
```{r svm-hierarchical-parallel}
workers <- min(4, future::availableCores())
future::plan(future::multisession, workers = workers)
 
svm_hiersyn <- furrr::future_map(
  names(sim_hierarchical),
  function(dataset_name) {
    single_dataset <- stats::setNames(
      list(sim_hierarchical[[dataset_name]]), dataset_name)
 
    synthesize_data_model(
      simulated_data = single_dataset,
      synth_method = list(name = "svm", func = synthesize_data_svm),
      mc_reps = 5)
  },
  .options = furrr::furrr_options(
    seed = TRUE,
    packages = c("purrr", "e1071", "FNN"))) %>%
  purrr::flatten()
 
save(svm_hiersyn,
     file = file.path(data_dir, "svm_hiersyn.RData"))
 
cat("Saved svm_hiersyn with", length(svm_hiersyn),
    "synthetic datasets.\n")
 
future::plan(future::sequential)
```

# Validation
```{r validation}
expected_synthetic_n <- length(sim_hierarchical) * 5
 
hier_objects <- c(
  "parm_hiersyn",
  "cart_hiersyn",
  "bn_hiersyn",
  "svm_hiersyn")
 
for (obj in hier_objects) {
 
  x <- get(obj)
 
  if (length(x) != expected_synthetic_n) {
    warning(obj, " contains ", length(x), " datasets; expected ", expected_synthetic_n, ".")
  } else {
    cat(obj, ":", length(x), "synthetic datasets -- OK\n")
  }
}
 
```
